scope: Coupled LRS Bianchi I conservation, constraint and small-anisotropy radiation limit; no novel global theorem claimed

scispace.question: How is the coupled Einstein–Vlasov evolution of collisionless massless radiation formulated for non-tilted locally rotationally symmetric Bianchi I cosmologies, including anisotropic pressure, shear, and propagation of the Hamiltonian constraint?

sources.authors: Ho Lee, Ernesto Nungesser, Paul Tod
sources.title: On the future of solutions to the massless Einstein-Vlasov system in a Bianchi I cosmology
sources.conventions: 8 pi G=c=1, k_ab=+dot g_ab/2; massless matter only in cited reduced system
supports: Bianchi I momenta p_i conserved between collisions and births
mixed shear evolution dot sigma=-3H sigma+pi
massless anisotropy moment hierarchy not closed at quadrupole alone
coupled small-anisotropy diagonal matrix and eigenvalues
sources.mapping: Our fixed parallel axis3 gives Sigma_plus=q/2, w_plus=A/6 with q=s/H and A=DeltaP/U. Similarity diag(2,6) maps source matrix [[-1,3],[-8/15,0]] to [[-1,1],[-8/5,0]].
sources.limits: Donor conversion, Lambda mixture and native spectral discretization are directly derived/tested here; not certified by the cited source.
